title: Deprecation and migration
summary: Plans the safe removal or replacement of old systems and APIs, including database changes with no downtime.
benefit: Old systems and database columns can be retired without downtime.
solves: Old systems that never get removed, and schema changes that break production during a rollout.
use_cases: Replacing an old system, API or library: build the replacement, announce, migrate step by step, remove.
"Should we keep or retire this?": five questions on value, users, replacement and cost.
Rename or drop a database column without downtime: expand, migrate, contract.
Patterns for moving users over: strangler, adapter and feature flag migration.
Dead code that nobody owns but everybody depends on: a plan to remove it safely.
details: When you retire or replace an old system, API or feature, or change a production database schema, Claude plans the stages: what still depends on it, what replaces it, how to move users over, and how to rename or drop a column without downtime. It is for you when you sunset or migrate something live. It copies a skill folder that loads only when used; instructions only, no code runs on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
